capabilities: Display a writing heatmap with daily totals and per-file changes
Keep a single-file journal with date headings
Manage one-time, daily, and weekly tasks with archiving and reordering
Fill in daily and weekly plan templates with time blocks
Arrange curated file groups and configure themed banners
extras: Desktop-only (mobile unsupported); requires Obsidian 1.8.7+; README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; no analytics or telemetry, with only an optional remote banner URL as an external request.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page that gathers writing activity, journaling, tasks, plans, and pinned files into a single configurable dashboard view.

relations.evidence: Install and enable BRAT from Community plugins.

summary: Desktop-only dashboard homepage combining a writing heatmap, date-section journal, task lists, daily/weekly plans, and curated file groups in one view.
